title: Container Bookings: Roll Compensation Scale and Customer Roll Allowances by Tier
content:
When a Container Bookings booking is moved to a later sailing, the tier decides what the line pays for a roll it caused and what the customer pays for a roll the customer caused. Both scales are tabulated here in US dollars.

## Rolls caused by the carrier

| Booking product | Compensation per container (USD) | Most compensation one booking can receive (USD) | Carrier rolls per booking that earn compensation |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 100.00 | 1500.00 | 1 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 200.00 | 3000.00 | 2 |
| AHL Premium Express | 350.00 | 5000.00 | 2 |

## Rolls caused by the customer

| Booking product | Customer roll fee per container (USD) | Customer rolls per booking without a fee | Most customer rolls one booking may take |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 150.00 | 0 | 1 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 100.00 | 1 | 2 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 75.00 | 1 | 3 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 50.00 | 2 | 3 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 120.00 | 0 | 1 |
| AHL Premium Express | 100.00 | 1 | 2 |

## Notes

- A carrier roll earns compensation only on the priority, guaranteed and express products; the two spot products and AHL Contract Booking stand at 0.00 throughout.
- AHL Spot Saver and AHL Guaranteed Loading grant no free customer roll, and each admits a single customer roll in the life of a booking.
- The third column of the second table is the total number of customer rolls the booking may ever receive, not a number of free ones.
